q: The topological conjugacy class of the tent map Tₐ (slope ±a) and the logistic map f_r are related by:
opts: For r = 4, the logistic map is conjugate to the full tent map T₂ via x = sin²(πθ/2)
They are conjugate only for r = 4 and a = 2
They have the same entropy but different dynamics
exp: At r = 4, fᵣ(x) = 4x(1-x) is topologically conjugate to the full tent map T₂ (slope ±2) via the semi-conjugacy θ ↦ sin²(πθ/2). Both have topological entropy log 2 and support the same ergodic measure (arcsine law for the logistic map).
